desc: The garden's vet booth (scripts/home/vet_booth.gd), beside the market stall in the hub. A check-up is free: health, likes and mood of every Boki on the island. Curing a weak or sick Boki (Care.ailing, the hunger cure of KinAiling) costs cure_gems.
cure_gems_doc: Gems for one cure. A snack cures the same for free, so the booth is the quick way for a player with a bare pantry.
moods_doc: [joy at least, word], highest first. Joy is the Boki's joy need, 0 to 100 (Care.NEEDS).
